verdict.rationale: No evidence Tailscale offers hardware-backed secure enclave storage for SSH keys protected by biometrics; the evidence pack only covers general VPN/mesh networking, SSH access, and Tailscale SSH auditing features, with nothing about enclave-based key storage or biometric protection. missing for 10: any documentation of hardware enclave/TPM/Secure Enclave key storage, biometric authentication for SSH key use.
